observations: My round-4 note is answered and I checked the answer rather than the claim: the back-fill no longer takes a live claimant's revision, and the live-claim rule is now one helper (indexLiveClaim) that both the index read and the back-fill's scan call, so the two paths can no longer disagree. The control run shows what the old shape cost — the claimant's answer refused and the delivery asked for a second time.

The marker's moment is written as the sweep's own `now`, which is at or before the scan it back-filled from, so it can only under-claim coverage; a sweep reads the index alone for at most Lookback after a back-fill, and the whole-record read is at most one an hour rather than one every two minutes. The e4 runs at MARKER_AGE=90 and the round-4 runs at a fresh marker show both sides of that boundary.
